option_relations.rationale: The option describes an acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction, which is a subtype of the leaf diseases B1.1 (Acute Coronary Syndrome with ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction) and B4.1 (ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction due to acute myocardial injury).

The option describes coronary artery disease progression with graft failure, which is a broader class containing the leaf diseases B1.2 (Non-ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction due to progressive coronary artery disease) and B1.4 (Coronary Artery Disease with Graft Failure).

The option describes an acute inferior ST-elevation myocardial infarction secondary to saphenous vein graft occlusion, which is equivalent to the leaf disease B1.1 (Acute Coronary Syndrome with ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction secondary to saphenous vein graft occlusion).

The option describes an acute posterior and inferior myocardial infarction, which is a subtype of the leaf diseases B1.1 (Acute Coronary Syndrome with ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction) and B4.1 (ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction due to acute myocardial injury).
